summary:
Implemented the Tabs feature without running any tests or repository code, and nothing is committed. Verification is by reading only, so the test expectations are unverified until someone runs the suite.

Changes:
- src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new): Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs, exported via __all__. Not re-exported from textual.widgets.
- src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py: yields one Text object; clickable_ranges inserted before width; click spans appended last; the zero-width early path returns before the click step.
- src/textual/renderables/opacity.py: blended color combined into the existing style so meta is preserved.
- docs/reference/tabs.md (new): single ::: textual.widgets.tabs.Tabs directive.
- tests/test_tabs.py (new); required underline tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py; one meta-preservation test appended to tests/renderables/test_opacity.py. Existing test code is unchanged (verified by diff: no removed lines in the underline test file; the opacity test file was restored from HEAD before appending).

Decisions:
- Layout resolver: no edit. Its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size (default 1), and fraction (default 1).
- Bar position uses the displayed index rather than the full-list find_tab_by_name result. This deviates from the literal spec for duplicates (e.g. [A, A, B]) so the underline sits under the displayed active tab, as acceptance criterion 11 requires. Keyboard navigation still uses find_tab_by_name.
- Letter search applies only to single-character keys.
- Inactive dimming uses a helper in tabs.py that mirrors Opacity's blend formula.
- Zero-width labels get no label edge, so they don't become flexible.
- Sandbox demo skipped (optional).

Unverified assumptions: rich 11.2.0 Style addition merges meta, and Text.stylize clamps spans to text length. I could not locate the installed rich source to confirm. Hand-computed expectations: width 10 with tabs A and B gives label row "  A    B  " and underline "━╸━╺━━━━━━".
